label: Red energy saber
note: Issue #148: an officer's saber the Remnant left aboard the crashed starcruiser; an old cargo droid in the deep hold carries it (droids.json, wreck.hauler). The dark master drops one where he falls (issue #303). Activated in the inventory (slot 'blade'; 'auto_on' false: never on by itself when taken or bought; 'toggle_labels' its button), it turns your energy sword red (blade_color) on a black metal hilt (hilt), and it fights as the energy blade does; put away, your sword is the blue one again. IP-neutral.
